title: Kalshi, Polymarket offer prediction markets tied to Mike Vrabel's future with Patriots

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kalshi, Polymarket offer prediction markets tied to Mike Vrabel's future with Patriots
sources.description: Given the developments to date and the possibility, if not inevitability, of more developments to come, it remains possible that Mike Vrabel won't remain the head coach of the Patriots.
